message.content: {"question":"We recall that an endomorphism f : V → V is said to be simple if there exists a basis of V of eigenvectors of f. Let us consider the endomorphism f : R³ → R³ defined by f(x,y,z) = (-x + z, -2y, x - z). Which of the following statements is correct?","options":{"A":"All the eigenspaces of f have dimension 1.","B":"The image of f has dimension 1.","C":"f is simple.","D":"f is an isomorphism."},"correct":"C"}
